blocks.content: Quiz: Which of the following is a good situation to use the <pre> tag?
Tap an option below to answer:
To emphasize important phrases within a paragraph.
To display a block of Python code where whitespaces are important.
Since whitespaces are crucial in Python code, using the <pre> tag is ideal in this situation.
Since whitespaces are crucial in Python code, using the <pre> tag is ideal in this situation.
To create a list of items.
We use either <ul> or <ol> tags to create a list of items.
We use either <ul> or <ol> tags to create a list of items.
To display prices neatly in a table format.
We use HTML tables for it.
We use HTML tables for it.
